independent_conclusion: Task failed during transport at 31.665 s. Opening the bag, one-left-arm holding, lifting and 90-degree wrist rotation were physically observed; insertion and release were not completed.

slip_evidence.interpretation: Transport first induced a few millimetres of lateral material slip while force remained at its 6 N cap and q remained above minimum. The material reference then approached/exceeded the pad half-width. Later rapid loss of contact coincided with fingers reaching minimum opening. Gap alone does not explain the initial drift; contact moment, lateral geometry and delayed squeeze following are contributing hypotheses.

rigid_contact_evidence.interpretation: No saved geometry evidence supports a robot/environment or robot/robot collision causing transport loss. Pair presence is not measured force, and offline positive distance does not prove native contact force was exactly zero.

neutral_collision_review.reason: Reference qpos0 is not the actual initialized pose; neutral-overlap filtering permanently removes potentially valid nonadjacent collision pairs. Enabling neutral collisions retains independent adjacent/weld filtering. Opposing central pads have local inner Y=0 and positive measured separation, so no compensating finger geometry change is needed.

recommendation: Keep the low-force head-region following probe bounded; require real lift and orientation retention before another full run. Do not exceed 6 N to mask the upper-arm slip. Reobserve deformed teddy shape after orientation before choosing the transport/insertion pose.
limitations: Full geometry and STC transforms are sampled at about 20 Hz; summary soft checks and actual q are sampled every 5 ms. No continuous-time collision proof is asserted.
STC projected normal/tangent forces are proxy wrench diagnostics, not individual native contact impulses or a complete force-closure proof.
The minimum tetrahedral volume ratio .095 is positive but indicates severe local compression; passing the .05 threshold does not establish realistic textile/filling response.
Coarse mesh results have not established fine-mesh or time-step convergence.

Cloth stretch, shear, bending and friction are engineering parameters, not calibrated from measured fabric. Teddy uses homogeneous compressible elasticity without a separate skin, polyfill or hysteresis.
Earlier runs before the rigid-contact fallback omitted delegated robot/table and robot/robot pairs; they cannot establish complete physical environment validity even when planned paths stayed clear.
